name: @starci/next-i18n
description: The next-intl stack of a StarCi Next.js front end, written once and generic over the app's locales: the typed routing config (defineI18n), the locale-negotiating proxy, the locale-aware navigation, the request config that loads the app's own message catalogs and the locale read of the [locale] layout. The app keeps its catalogs and names its locales.
author: starci183

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}).filter((n) => n.endsWith('.d.ts'))) fs.writeFileSync('dist/' + f, fs.readFileSync('dist/' + f, 'utf8').replace(/((?:from |import\()['\x22]\.\.?\/[^'\x22]+)\.ts(['\x22])/g, (all, head, quote) => head + '.js' + quote))"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && node --import ./src/next-esm.setup.ts --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-exclude="src/**/*.spec.ts" --test-coverage-exclude="src/**/*.setup.ts" --test-coverage-lines=90 "src/**/*.spec.ts"
